239e97f44e78df33.job_title: Rigger - Turbine Outages & Precision Equipment Handler (Saudi Arabia)
239e97f44e78df33.description: Job Description The Turbine & Precision Equipment Rigger is responsible for executing highly critical, heavy, and precision lifting operations during power plant turbine outages and industrial maintenance shutdowns. This role demands exceptional technical expertise to safely handle multi-million dollar rotating equipment, gas/steam turbine components, and delicate machinery within tightly restricted spaces. The successful candidate must strictly adhere to engineered lifting plans, maintain zero-compromise safety standards, and display flawless precision under fast-paced outage timelines. Key Responsibilities Rigging Execution: Safely attach, lift, guide, and position heavy turbine components and associated mechanical equipment in strict compliance with approved, engineered lifting plans . Pre-Lift Assessment: Thoroughly review critical technical parameters prior to every lift, including total load weight, exact center of gravity , designated lifting points, travel path clearances, and final landing arrangements. Equipment Management: Select, calculate, and inspect specialized rigging hardware such as synthetic/wire-rope slings, shackles, spreader beams , chain blocks, and specialized lifting accessories. Compliance & Safety Verification: Audit all lifting tackle before use to verify valid identification tags, current inspection status, and Working Load Limits (WLL) . Precision Maneuvering: Expertly guide immense structural loads through highly restricted areas and congested plant environments utilizing controlled mechanical methods and precise signaling. Experience: Minimum of 3 to 5 years of proven experience as an industrial rigger, with a strong preference for candidates who have completed major turbine outages, power plant shutdowns, or heavy mechanical maintenance . Technical Skills: Comprehensive knowledge of rigging mathematics, center-of-gravity calculations, crane signals, and rigging hardware capacities. Certifications: Valid third-party rigging certifications (such as TUV, Bureau Veritas, Aramco, or equivalents ) are highly preferred. Physical Capability: Ability to work in confined spaces, at heights, and handle the physical demands of 12-hour shifts typical during emergency or scheduled outages. Soft Skills: Strong teamwork orientation, high attention to detail, and a strict commitment to safety protocols.

235739bafd9c7ddf.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة فريق البلوط للتجارة عن بائع قطع غيار مركبات للانضمام إلى فريقها في مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور على بيع قطع غيار المركبات للزبائن، وتقديم معلومات دقيقة حول المنتجات، وإدارة عمليات الدفع والمخزون. هذه فرصة بدوام كامل للمرشحين ذوي الخبرة من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال ذي صلة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية بيع مجموعة متنوعة من قطع غيار المركبات للزبائن. توفير معلومات شاملة للزبائن تتعلق بقطع غيار المركبات، بما في ذلك الاستخدامات والأسعار. مراقبة مستويات المخزون بانتظام، والحفاظ على ترتيب المتجر، وإصدار طلبات الشراء للمنتجات عند الحاجة. التعامل مع المنتجات الواردة والتأكد من تسجيلها وتخزينها بشكل صحيح. إدارة عمليات الدفع وتلقي المدفوعات من الزبائن بكفاءة. معالجة طلبات استبدال المنتجات والمرتجعات وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المتبعة في الشركة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال بيع قطع الغيار أو المبيعات بالتجزئة. القدرة على التعامل مع الزبائن وتقديم خدمة ممتازة. معرفة بقطع غيار المركبات واستخداماتها تعتبر ميزة إضافية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تواصل ممتازة ولباقة في التعامل مع الآخرين. القدرة على إدارة الوقت وتنظيم المهام بكفاءة. الدقة والانتباه للتفاصيل في إدارة المخزون والمعاملات المالية. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مكة المكرمة. ستعمل ضمن فريق مبيعات ديناميكي يهدف إلى تحقيق رضا الزبائن وتلبية احتياجاتهم بفعالية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم مناقشته خلال عملية المقابلة.

Business Plan Development Support and Compliance Review · Lead business unit Development Financial Analysis teams in the preparation of five-year execution plans, providing structured business planning guidance throughout the plan development process to promote consistency with established planning standards. · Review, validate, and assess the compliance of development business plans submitted at each stage gate, ensuring submissions reflect approved scope, financial assumptions, realistic execution timelines, and established business planning standards prior to governance review. · Provide structured feedback to business unit Development Financial Analysis teams on business plan submissions requiring refinement, ensuring identified gaps are addressed and submissions satisfy business planning and governance requirements prior to resubmission. Strategic Planning Support and Governance · Support development relevant stakeholders in strategic business planning by providing planning analysis, portfolio insights, and recommendations to inform development priorities and organizational decision-making. · Liaise with business unit Development Financial Analysis leaders through the Finance Project Control Group to communicate business planning standards, gather implementation feedback, and promote the consistent adoption of approved business planning methodologies. Oversee the business plan governance process, ensuring governance requirements are effectively coordinated, business plan submissions comply with established governance obligations, and governance deliverables are prepared in accordance with committee and stage gate requirements. Generic Responsibilities: Policies, Processes, and Procedures · Lead the implementation of a comprehensive framework of policies and procedures for the Business Planning function, while establishing a system for monitoring and improving the framework, and drive the implementation of industry-leading practices. Stakeholder Management · Support the Business Planning Lead in engagements for the Business Planning function, build towards open communication and accountability among key stakeholders. Change Management · Lead the initiatives for continuous improvement of the Business Planning function systems, processes, and practices, relevant in the QIC environment take actions where needed Reporting · Support preparation of accurate and timely reporting for the Business Planning function, so that all reports support the wider-business and meet Qiddiya's needs and standards. Additional Duties This job description outlines the duties that are typically performed by the jobholder; these duties are not the only responsibilities required by the role, and management may assign additional tasks as necessary. Preferred: Master’s degree in Finance, Real Estate Finance, Business Administration (MBA), Economics, or a related field. Required: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field. Professional certifications or memberships within recognized finance, investment, or real estate institutes (e.g., CFA, ACCA, CIMA, RICS) are preferred. 8-12 years of experience in development finance, real estate business planning, financial analysis, or related fields is required Demonstrates experience in accountability of construction of real estate assets, business planning and financial analysis within a real estate development or comparable large-scale development environment, supporting structured business planning and execution processes, reviewing and validating development business plans across multiple asset classes, and supporting structured stage gate governance processes. Demonstrates fluency in written and verbal English, with proficiency in Arabic advantageous Interprets complex information and analysis to inform decision-making, and address ambiguity Manages relationships with internal and external stakeholders, facilitating cross-functional collaboration and ensuring alignment on priorities and initiatives. Demonstrates deep expertise in development business planning, with hands-on experience across diverse asset classes and development typologies. Applies advanced understanding of development governance and investment approval processes, including the ability to review and challenge business plan submissions against organizational standards to ensure they are accurate, complete, and ready for senior leadership endorsement.

233930a83667bdf1.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة زهير عيسى الشويخات للنظارات عن أخصائي بصريات للانضمام إلى فريقها في القطيف، المنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تجهيز النظارات الطبية والعدسات اللاصقة، بالإضافة إلى صيانة النظارات وإعداد التقارير المتعلقة بالبصريات. المسؤوليات الرئيسية تجهيز النظارات الطبية بناءً على نتائج الفحص أو وصفة الطبيب المعالج. اختيار إطار النظارة بالتنسيق مع العميل. تفصيل عدسات النظارات الطبية وتجهيزها وتركيبها على الإطار. تجهيز وتركيب العدسات اللاصقة، وتدريب المرضى على كيفية نزعها وتركيبها وتعقيمها وترطيبها. صيانة النظارات الطبية لضمان جودتها وفعاليتها. مواكبة التطورات في مجال البصريات وتطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتعلقة بالبصريات وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة، بما يتوافق مع السياسات والإجراءات المنظمة. ضمان تطبيق مبادئ وقواعد السلامة العامة خلال جميع أعمال البصريات. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال البصريات. القدرة على العمل بدوام كامل. مهارات تواصل جيدة للتعامل مع العملاء وتدريبهم. بيئة العمل يعمل أخصائي البصريات ضمن فريق في مؤسسة زهير عيسى الشويخات للنظارات، ويقع مقر العمل في مدينة القطيف بالمنطقة الشرقية. يتطلب الدور التزاماً بالعمل بدوام كامل لضمان تقديم أفضل خدمة للعملاء. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده ومناقشته خلال المقابلة الشخصية.

23f2a827398c2693.description: About the Role Baraya Extended Care is seeking a General Practitioner to join their team in Abha, 'Asir, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time, supervised, transitional training position designed for medical graduates to develop clinical skills across primary care and common inpatient presentations. The role involves providing baseline patient care under the guidance of supervising physicians and participating in learning activities, documentation, and quality improvement initiatives. Job Scope The General Practitioner will work across outpatient clinics and inpatient services under designated supervision. This position emphasizes continuity of care, appropriate escalation, and safe patient handling. Practitioners will participate in rounds, morning huddles, and specialty clinics as part of structured rotation schedules, gaining exposure to internal medicine, family medicine, pediatrics, obstetrics, and minor procedures within their scope. The role is designed to foster professional development, clinical reasoning, and adherence to evidence-based practice while ensuring patient safety and compliance with regulatory policies. Key Responsibilities Provide supervised patient care across outpatient and inpatient settings. Support supervising physicians in the assessment, planning, and execution of care. Document patient encounters accurately and maintain complete medical records. Participate in rounds, clinics, and departmental educational activities. Identify learning needs, seek feedback, and engage in ongoing professional development. Ensure patient safety, infection control, and adherence to policies and guidelines. Participate in quality improvement and patient safety initiatives. Essential Functions Take comprehensive patient histories and perform focused physical examinations. Order and interpret basic laboratory tests and imaging as appropriate. Initiate, adjust, or discontinue treatment plans under supervision. Provide patient education on diagnoses, medications, and follow-up plans. Assist with preventive care, vaccination counseling, and health promotion. Participate in discharge planning and coordinated transitions of care. Respond to clinical questions and seek timely supervision for complex decisions. Contribute to case discussions, clinical audits, and learning projects. Comply with regulatory, ethical, and institutional policies. Qualifications and Experience Medical graduate. 2-5 years of relevant experience. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Abha, 'Asir, Saudi Arabia, involving work across outpatient clinics and inpatient services.

232d1ed5cbe5ecf1.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة مصنع قطاعات عن فني معادن للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور إلى تنفيذ المهام الفنية لدعم الأبحاث في علم المعادن والمساهمة في تطوير التطبيقات الصناعية والعملية. هذه فرصة بدوام كامل للمرشحين ذوي الخبرة من 0 إلى 1 سنة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تشغيل معدات وآلات التصنيع والإنتاج وفقاً لإجراءات العمل المعتمدة. تنفيذ أعمال قص وتجهيز وتجميع قطاعات الألمنيوم والمعادن حسب المواصفات الفنية. استخدام أدوات القياس والفحص لضمان دقة الأبعاد وجودة المنتج. تنفيذ أعمال التغليف والتعبئة للمنتجات النهائية وتجهيزها للتخزين أو الشحن. المساهمة في عمليات الإنتاج وتقديم الدعم للفريق الفني عند الحاجة. فحص المنتجات واكتشاف العيوب وإبلاغ المسؤول المباشر بأي ملاحظات. المحافظة على سلامة المعدات والأدوات المستخدمة والإبلاغ عن الأعطال. الالتزام بتطبيق معايير الجودة والسلامة والصحة المهنية داخل المصنع. المحافظة على نظافة وترتيب منطقة العمل. تنفيذ أي مهام أخرى ذات صلة بطبيعة العمل يكلف بها من قبل المسؤول المباشر. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على تشغيل المعدات والآلات الصناعية. معرفة جيدة بإجراءات السلامة والجودة المهنية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات فنية في التعامل مع المعادن والألمنيوم. دقة في استخدام أدوات القياس والفحص. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق. الالتزام بمعايير الجودة والسلامة. بيئة العمل يعمل فني المعادن في بيئة مصنع بمدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة، ضمن فريق فني متخصص. يتطلب الدور التزاماً بمعايير السلامة والصحة المهنية. معلومات إضافية نوع الوظيفة: دوام كامل. الراتب: لم يتم الإفصاح عنه.

2357bbca40249589.job_title: Senior Manager Commercial Operations Middle East
2357bbca40249589.description: About Applied Intuition Applied Intuition, Inc. is a Silicon Valley company founded in 2017, valued at $15 billion, that develops digital infrastructure for physical AI. The company supports the automotive, defense, trucking, construction, mining, and agriculture industries through tools and infrastructure, operating systems, and autonomy solutions. Applied Intuition's solutions are trusted by eighteen of the top 20 global automakers, as well as the United States military and its allies. Headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, Applied Intuition maintains offices globally, including Washington, *, London, Stuttgart, Munich, Stockholm, Bangalore, Seoul, and Tokyo. This is a full-time, in-office position based in Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Employees are expected to primarily work from the Applied Intuition office five days a week, with flexibility for occasional remote work or adjusted schedules to accommodate personal commitments. The Role: Vehicle Operations Lead Middle East Applied Intuition is seeking a Vehicle Operations Lead for the Middle East region, specifically in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This role involves owning vehicle operations for the SDS platform across the region, beginning with the on-road commercial trucking program and expanding to additional vehicle platforms and customer programs as the company scales. The Lead will manage end-to-end operational execution for SDS on-road programs, from fleet and site readiness to daily operations, validation, and continuous feedback to engineering, ensuring SDS-enabled vehicles operate safely, compliantly, and efficiently on public roads. This position offers a perspective on the development of cutting-edge autonomy technology while collaborating with major industry players globally. Key Responsibilities Lead regional vehicle operations, overseeing operational execution for SDS on-road programs, starting with commercial trucking and expanding to other vehicle platforms. Manage fleet and site readiness, daily execution, and operational performance across vehicle programs. Drive regional growth strategy, including the ramp plan for scaling operations across local programs. Develop operational playbooks covering safety, on-road execution, incident response, and escalation, applicable across various vehicle types. Collaborate with engineering, product, safety, legal, and OEM/fleet partners to align program milestones with safe and efficient execution. Implement safety protocols and best practices to meet regulatory standards in public-road environments. Qualifications and Requirements Over 10 years of experience, with a proven track record in leading on-road commercial vehicle, autonomy, or complex fleet operations. Experience establishing and scaling multiple operational programs or vehicle lines. Demonstrated ownership of safety processes and incident response for public-road operations. Comfortable operating in hands-on, real-world environments with commercial vehicles. Experience partnering directly with OEMs, regulators, or fleet customers to achieve operational outcomes. Experience managing multi-site or international operations, considering local regulations and infrastructure constraints. Preferred Qualifications Background at a truck OEM or commercial vehicle manufacturer (*, Daimler Trucks, Volvo Trucks, PACCAR, Isuzu, Toyota, Ford Pro). Experience with ADAS or on-road autonomy validation across various vehicle types. Familiarity with Tier-1 supplier relationships (*, Bosch, Continental, ZF, Aptiv). Knowledge of KSA/regional regulatory and infrastructure requirements for commercial vehicle operations. Compensation and Benefits Compensation for eligible roles at Applied Intuition includes base salary, equity, and benefits. The total compensation package may include equity in the form of options and/or restricted stock units, comprehensive health, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance coverage, 401k retirement benefits with employer match, learning and wellness stipends, and paid time off. Benefits are subject to change and may vary based on the jurisdiction of employment. The actual base salary offered will be influenced by factors such as experience, credentials, educational attainment, skill level, and interview performance.

2359aeb28552cf66.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مجمع عيادات سمايا الطبي عن طبيب أسنان عام للانضمام إلى فريقه في أبها، عسير. يتولى شاغل الوظيفة مسؤولية تشخيص وعلاج أمراض الفم والأسنان المختلفة، بالإضافة إلى متابعة حالات المرضى وتقديم الرعاية السنية الشاملة. هذا الدور متاح بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إجراء الفحص الشامل لأسنان المرضى، وتحديد الصور الشعاعية اللازمة، وتحليلها لتشخيص الحالات المرضية للفم والأسنان بدقة. وضع خطط علاجية متكاملة وبرامج زمنية مناسبة لكل حالة مرضية. تجهيز وتطبيق الحشوات السنية ومعالجة القنوات اللبية للأسنان. تنظيف الأسنان وإزالة الرواسب الكلسية لضمان صحة الفم واللثة. تحديد احتياجات المرضى من التعويضات السنية، وأخذ القياسات اللازمة، ومتابعة تنفيذها وتركيبها وضبطها. فحص اللثة وتشخيص أمراضها، ومعالجة التهابات اللثة، وإجراء جراحات الفم الصغرى عند الضرورة. وصف العلاجات والأدوية المناسبة للمرضى بناءً على التشخيص. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة أحدث التطورات في مجال طب الأسنان. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير الطبية المتعلقة بأعمال طب الأسنان وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المتبعة. ضمان تطبيق مبادئ وقواعد السلامة العامة أثناء القيام بمختلف أعمال طب وصحة الأسنان. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة شهادة جامعية في طب الأسنان. خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال طب الأسنان العام. القدرة على تشخيص وعلاج مجموعة واسعة من أمراض الفم والأسنان. مهارات ممتازة في التواصل مع المرضى وتقديم الرعاية اللازمة. المهارات الشخصية دقة الملاحظة والاهتمام بالتفاصيل. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق طبي متعدد التخصصات. الالتزام بالمعايير المهنية والأخلاقية. مهارات تنظيمية وإدارية جيدة لإعداد التقارير وحفظ السجلات. بيئة العمل يعمل طبيب الأسنان العام في مجمع عيادات سمايا الطبي في أبها، عسير، ضمن بيئة عمل احترافية وداعمة. الوظيفة بدوام كامل، وتهدف إلى تقديم أفضل مستويات الرعاية الصحية للمرضى. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين ممن تنطبق عليهم المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم للانضمام إلى فريقنا.

238fa7b53c829b51.description: About the Program Manager Role Airbus Helicopters Arabia for Aircraft Maintenance is seeking a Program Manager to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This is a contract position requiring 0-1 years of experience. The Program Manager will be responsible for the execution and performance of multiple projects for a specific customer, ensuring alignment with Project Management best practices and Airbus Helicopters Arabia (AHA) policies and management system. Role Overview The Program Manager will oversee the risks, scope, schedule, and costs of assigned projects. This role requires a strong commitment to integrity and an awareness of potential compliance risks, which are fundamental to the company's success and reputation. The successful candidate will play a key role in maintaining project standards and customer satisfaction. Key Responsibilities Comply with all Aviation and Export Control Regulations. Develop project plans and contract deliverables. Manage project budget, schedule, scope, and risk. Manage all aspects of planning, monitoring, and execution of contracts. Identify, review, and analyze project risks, then assess and implement mitigation actions. Coordinate operational aspects of projects between the project team and liaise with finance, HR, and management as required. Manage and communicate with internal and external stakeholders. Prepare and deliver internal and external reporting (weekly, monthly, quarterly, etc.). Perform contract reviews with AHA and Corporate management. Perform project close-out and document lessons learned and best practices throughout the project life cycle. Manage and control customer expectations and change requests. Conduct site visits at customer locations as required. Respond to customer complaints and concerns in a timely manner. Improve customer satisfaction by delivering consistent results and following up on any concerns. Participate in the continuous improvement of Project Management processes. Required Experience 0-1 years of experience in a relevant field. Work Type and Location This is a contract position based in Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role involves managing projects for a specific customer and requires adherence to both internal policies and external regulations. Application Information Salary for this position will be disclosed during the recruitment process.

23c8678a993a3ea7.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مصنع البيوت الأنيقة للابواب والنوافذ الخشبية عن مهندس تصميم مواقع للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذا الدور مسؤولية تصميم الحدائق والمرافق الترفيهية والمساحات الخارجية المتنوعة، مع تقديم الدعم في اختيار المواقع والإشراف على أعمال الإنشاءات. هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية وضع التصاميم لمشاريع التزيين الخارجي والمساحات الخضراء، وإدارة فريق التصميم في اختيار المواد وتطوير المواصفات الفنية. إعداد نماذج بالحجم الطبيعي والرسومات الفنية والنماذج الرقمية للمشاريع. المساعدة في عملية اختيار المقاولين والموردين، واختيار المواد المناسبة للمشاريع. تقديم الدعم الفني لمشروعات تنسيق المواقع والحدائق والمساحات الخضراء، ومباشرة تنفيذ التصميم من قِبل المقاولين. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية، وتوثيق نسب تقدمها وعرضها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال تصميم المواقع أو تنسيق الحدائق. القدرة على تصميم الحدائق ومرافق الاستجمام والمنازل الخاصة وغيرها من الأماكن المفتوحة. القدرة على المساعدة في اختيار المواقع ومباشرة أعمال الإنشاءات. بيئة العمل يعمل المهندس في بيئة عمل داعمة في مدينة الرياض، ضمن فريق متخصص في مصنع البيوت الأنيقة للابواب والنوافذ الخشبية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات. التقديم ندعو المهندسين المؤهلين والمهتمين بهذا الدور للتقديم.

23d62e00dae95cd0.description: About MPFM - Multi Paths Facilities Management Multi Paths Facilities Management Services (MPFM), a subsidiary of MPCCO, specializes in providing innovative and sustainable facility and property management solutions across Saudi Arabia. The company develops custom programs, ranging from specialized cleaning to fully integrated facility management, tailored to client operational needs. With over 5,000 skilled professionals and a presence in more than four major cities, MPFM supports diverse sectors including food and beverage, hospitals, retail, warehouses, and logistics. The organization focuses on complex outsourcing and manpower support, aiming to be a strategic partner for its clients. Executive Secretary Role Overview MPFM is seeking an Executive Secretary to join its team in Makkah. 239101eecde42af0.description: About the Role Over 100,000 merchants run their businesses on Salla, and every order they win ends the same way: something physical has to reach a customer. Shipping is where the platform stops being software. This role owns the shipping stack end to end and the economics underneath it: courier integrations, routing, cash-on-delivery reconciliation, exceptions, and partner performance, plus how far past last-mile delivery we go into inventory placement, warehousing, pick and pack, first-mile pickup, and returns. You lead a dedicated engineering squad as its one accountable product owner, and you own what a shipment costs and what the platform keeps on it. Few product roles let you own a merchant experience and its unit economics at the same time. This one does. You will drive impact across four major domains: Shipping Products (routing, label issuance, cash on delivery, tracking, driver-facing tools) Partner Integrations (provider onboarding, interface quality, status mapping, reconciliation, platform stability) Fulfillment Beyond Last Mile (inventory placement, warehousing and third-party orchestration, pick and pack, first-mile pickup, returns) Shipping Economics (carrier mix, rate card design, cost per successful delivery, what the platform charges and what it keeps) Responsibilities: Own the strategy and roadmap for shipping and fulfillment, prioritized on merchant retention and contribution per shipment, not feature count. Decide how each order is routed and priced: which provider carries it, at what service level, at what cost, and what the merchant pays. Raise delivery reliability where it is measurable: first-attempt success, service-level accuracy, exception rate, return to origin, and cash-on-delivery reconciliation. Build the integration layer that makes onboarding a new provider fast and keeps it stable once live: status mapping, retries, fallbacks, monitoring. Extend the product past last-mile delivery, choosing capabilities on merchant retention impact rather than on integration ease. Decide which shipping capability is free and which is paid, and defend where the line sits. Own the metrics with the data team, and move volume between providers when the performance data says to. Proven ownership of a shipping, fulfillment, or order-management product on a platform serving many businesses at once, with the numbers you moved: delivery success rate, service-level accuracy, exception rate, cash-on-delivery accuracy, or cost per shipment. Commercial fluency in shipment economics: you have built, priced, or renegotiated a rate card, and can explain how zone, weight, service level, cash on delivery, surcharges, and failed deliveries move cost per parcel. Depth past last-mile delivery in at least two of: inventory placement, warehousing or third-party fulfillment orchestration, pick and pack, first-mile pickup, reverse logistics, cross-border. Technical grounding in integrations: interfaces, webhooks, status mapping, retries, reconciliation. You can explain how a courier integration actually breaks and what made yours stable long term. Experience as the single product owner for a dedicated engineering squad, working across operations, commercial, and support rather than around them. Strongly preferred: you have built product on top of a partner network, where the company sold partner capacity and built its own capability alongside it. Seven or more years in product management. Full professional fluency in Arabic and English is required, and GCC logistics context is preferred over theoretical knowledge. Willing to relocate to Saudi Arabia.

Manage day-to-day order fulfillment, logistics coordination, and customer service across all platforms. Own the e-commerce strategy, KPIs, and P&L to drive sales and profitability. Handle account management of all sales channel partners and vendors. Lead workflows for new product setup and listings (strong writing skills in Arabic and English required). Ensure content, pricing, and inventory accuracy across the website and marketplaces. Collaborate with marketing, tech, and product teams to improve site UX, traffic, and conversion rates. 23038b2dc8ce6798.job_title: Finance & Revenue Cycle Management Specialist (Saudi Arabia)
23038b2dc8ce6798.description: Eram Talent is searching for a Finance & Revenue Cycle Management Specialist to join our team in Saudi Arabia. This role is essential in ensuring the effective financial management of the organization's revenue cycle processes. The specialist will be responsible for analyzing financial data, optimizing revenue streams, and ensuring compliance with financial regulations and policies. This role is crucial in ensuring the accurate, timely, and transparent validation of invoices, quotations, and insurance claims across all providers and insurers. The position requires close coordination with the operator, insurers, and internal finance teams to ensure compliance, reduce rejections, and improve financial sustainability. Responsibilities Financial Oversight: Review and validate all invoices submitted by the operator for accuracy and compliance. Review and validate quotations for services and ensure alignment with agreed contractual terms. Collaborate with Finance and KAUST leadership on budget adherence, forecasting, and expenditure control. Lead the preparation, monitoring, and control of annual budgets in alignment with KAUST Health's strategic and operational goals. Provide monthly financial analysis and variance reports with recommendations for corrective actions. Insurance & Revenue Cycle Management: Oversee the monthly insurance claim submission process across all insurance companies. Validate claim accuracy, completeness, and compliance with insurance requirements. Monitor rejection rates and develop action plans to reduce claim denials and improve collection timelines. Lead reconciliation meetings with the operator and insurers to resolve discrepancies. Ensure transparency and accountability in claim and payment processes. Reporting & Analysis: Provide regular financial and insurance claim performance reports to senior leadership. Track KPIs related to financial and revenue cycle performance. identify risks and opportunities for revenue optimization. Work closely with the Head of Health, Operations Manager, and Finance department to ensure alignment of financial and operational objectives. Support audits and ensure compliance with internal and external financial regulations. Bachelor’s degree (required) in Finance or Accounting (preferred). Master’s degree in Finance (preferred). Professional certifications (e.g., CPA, CMA) are an advantage. Minimum 6 years of experience, with at least 3 years in a lead role. Proven experience in the healthcare sector finance, insurance, or revenue cycle management. Strong background in financial analysis, budgeting, and reporting. Hands-on experience with insurance claim processes, validation, and reconciliation. Demonstrated experience in preparing, managing, and monitoring budgets within a healthcare environment.

23a52d0d5ca3bb64.job_title: Project Manager - Railway Safety & O&M (Saudi Arabia)
23a52d0d5ca3bb64.description: The Project Manager will lead and manage railway safety and inspection activities for key railway operation and maintenance projects across Saudi Arabia. The role requires extensive experience in railway systems focusing on safety compliance, technical inspection, accident investigation, and regulatory oversight, ensuring the highest standards of railway operation safety. Responsibilities: Conduct scheduled supervisory visits and technical inspections at major railway projects (e.g., Haramain High-Speed Railway, Riyadh Metro, Etihad Rail). Lead on-site investigations immediately following railway accidents or incidents. Prepare and submit detailed monitoring and investigation reports within prescribed timelines (usually within two weeks). Review, update, and contribute to railway policies, regulations, and procedural documents as requested by regulatory authorities. Participate in meetings with railway operators and government transport authorities, both remote and in-person. Verify operator compliance with safety certifications, operating licenses, and regulatory requirements during inspections. Provide continuous technical support and respond promptly to queries from the Authority staff between site visits. Ensure all inspection and investigation activities strictly comply with official safety standards and protocols. Minimum of 20 years’ experience in railway systems, safety, operation, and maintenance (O&M). Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Safety Management, or related technical field. Master’s degree is preferred. Proven experience conducting technical investigations of railway accidents or incidents. Hands-on experience with railway operation, maintenance protocols, and safety standards. Prior experience working on railway projects in Saudi Arabia or GCC countries is highly desirable. Strong knowledge of international best practices for railway safety and inspection.
